peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 7% above its local comparables; 73 of 85 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (22.7): 1.8 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 58 of 266 similar developments with a figure (the same as 5). Context, not scored: resales in 50% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,410,000 ($1,323 psf, 1,065–1,108 sq ft; 7 resales, Oct 2024–Sep 2026); 6 comparable developments within 5 km: median $1,275 psf (range $1,048–1,451); 3.8% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $51,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $1,769,000 ($1,329 psf, 1,291–1,367 sq ft; 6 resales, Jun 2024–May 2026); 6 comparable developments within 5 km: median $1,206 psf (range $1,161–1,332); 10.2% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $164,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Pasir Ris MRT about 990 m, Tampines MRT about 2,070 m; closer than 48 of 462 similar developments (the same as 4). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 7 within 2 km; nearest Park View Primary School about 350 m; more than 340 of 462 similar developments (the same as 68). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 4 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 510 m), more than 288 of 462 similar developments (the same as 94); nearest hawker centre Tampines North Hawker Centre about 870 m; nearest park Sg Api Api Park about 600 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Upcoming on the Cross Island Line: Tampines North MRT about 410 m (LTA target 2030) and Elias MRT about 700 m (LTA target 2032), both under construction. Straight-line distances to the planned station sites; entrances are not yet published.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 1 other condo development sold new homes within 2 km (Parktown Residence, 73 new sales, about 870 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 25 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 718 new sales and 401 resales (1,119 purchases); new sales were 64.2% of these purchases. Subsales (25) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 401 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 43 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 401 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 369 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (+8.7%). Planning-area private resales −4%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
